newsitem.title: CHINA: Saudi Aramco's Petrolube appoints China agent.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Aramco's Petrolube appoints China agent.

text.p: Saudi Arabia Petromin Lubricating Oil Co (Petrolube), a unit of oil giant Saudi Aramco, on Friday appointed China's Shenzhen Pengjunda Industry Investment Co as its Chinese general sales agent, the Xinhua news agency said.
Xinhua called the agreement between Petrolube and Penjunda, which is based in the southern city of Shenzhen, a breakthrough in economic cooperation between China and Saudi Arabia.
It gave no financial details of the deal, but said experts believed the introduction of the Saudi firm's products would to help ease domestic industry's urgent need for quality lubricants.
China could produce about 350,000 tonnes of lubricated oil a year, but was forced to import a further 300,000 tonnes of high-grade lubricants, it said but gave no details.
